t: In front of you is a statue of Thomas Cubitt, standing at the corner of Denbigh Street and St George's Drive in Pimlico. Cubitt was a master builder, and he's remembered for developing many of London's historic streets and squares, especially in Belgravia, Bloomsbury and here in Pimlico. So it's fitting that he's commemorated in the area he helped build. The statue was made by William Fawke, an English sculptor who made portrait busts and created several statues on commission.
